# webtables/return

> Return: restores the stack pointer, then returns the value.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/return.pkg) · translates [std/return](../std/return.md)

At the top level, the value becomes the exit code.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when value missing `

```nasm
(global.set $sp (local.get $top))
(return (i64.const 0))
```

### `emit`

```nasm
(local.set $ret
{value}
)
(global.set $sp (local.get $top))
(return (local.get $ret))
```
